title: Cloud Atlas
author: David Mitchell
summary: Six nested stories, from a nineteenth-century sea voyage to a far-future island, each in a different genre and voice. Every narrative is discovered by a character in the next one.
readIf: you like ambitious structure and genre-hopping, and enjoy spotting how the pieces echo one another.
skipIf: you want to settle into one character and plot, or find stylised dialects hard going.

pairings.reason: Another novel of stories nested within stories, where the tales and their readers keep intersecting.
A gentler, more focused novel that links separate lives across time through a single thread.
Plays with time and genre in a shorter, angrier and more satirical way.
